description.en:
Schedules a jump to another map, done when the event ends: the map ID and the arrival position and direction are stored. The ev_main helper ReserveMapJump wraps it.
The position array is read for up to 4 numbers (x, y, z, direction in degrees); missing values are 0. When a third argument is given, it sets (true) or clears (false) bit 0x80 of the event system flags; ReserveMapJump calls this argument bgmOff (its effect on the BGM was not traced).
[x, y, z, direction]; values missing from the array are 0.
Sets or clears event flag bit 0x80 (named bgmOff by ReserveMapJump).

true once scheduled.
null if pos is given but is not an array, the jump could not be scheduled, the script system is not ready or no argument is given.
